title: Stan Romanek: contactee and hybrid photograph

tellings.quote: >> Well, he he was he was a contact major contacty. He had all these uh beings. They actually had the photograph of the of the uh of one of the hybrids that his wife took.

plain: In the 2000s, north of Denver, Colorado, a man named Stan Romanek said he was in regular contact with beings, and his wife is said to have photographed one of the part-human, part-alien "hybrids." The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells it, calling Romanek "a major contactee," someone who says he has ongoing contact with beings, who "had all these beings" around him. Cameron tells it as a case he knew of, with the photograph as its evidence.
